title: Historical compatibility performance invocation omitted its target-era sanitation authority

source_observation.environment: Exact immutable 2.5.0 baseline and 2.5.5 candidate on trusted Factorio 2.0.77
source_observation.fact: The large 2.0 AAI scenario completed its Factorio load successfully, but the current compatibility command defaulted its sanitation budget to the active 2.1 repository authority. The immutable 2.0 worktree has the governed local-2-0-aai-suite budget; it was simply not passed to the command.

reproducer.expected: Every historical compatibility lane passes both its declared target-era manual scenario and target-era sanitation policy to the current execution command.
reproducer.observed: After a passing Factorio process, compatibility audit reported no governed sanitation budget for local-2-0-aai-suite because it read the active default authority.

stable_id_and_migration_impact: none; target-era compatibility policy binding only
